_comment: Reviewed intentional free wire ends in the Appendix J schematics.
audit_appendix_j_geometry.py fails on any dangling endpoint that is not
listed here, and also fails when a listed entry becomes connected (a stale
whitelist), so this file cannot rot silently.
Scope: only the ten sch-* schematics. The seven sym-* symbol plates display
each glyph in isolation with its own terminals exposed, so they are covered

sch-05-ambiguity-stabilizer.note: The XOR gate is a labelled inset showing the exactly-one rule, not a wired stage. Its two input leads and its output lead are deliberately exposed so the reader recognises the glyph.

sch-09-memory-cell.note: Refresh-pump terminals. The pump is drawn as a source symbol; the dashed refresh line leaves its body outline and returns charge to the retention node.

sch-10-cpmb-supply.note: Crossbar tips of the seven Drive rails. Each rail is a bus bar; its left and right ends are open by convention, and its centre tap is bonded to the supply bus at y=27.5.
